LightningComponentBundle.description: Reusable envelope list with search, filters, and styled data table for Experience Cloud and in-app shells.

property.name: hideNewEnvelopeButton
property.label: Hide New Envelope Button
property.description: Hides the New Envelope button in the toolbar and empty state.

property.name: hideRowActions
property.label: Hide Row Actions
property.description: Hides the per-row rename and delete menu.

property.name: enableSearch
property.label: Enable Search
property.description: Shows the search input in the toolbar.

property.name: enableLastActivityFilter
property.label: Enable Last Activity Filter
property.description: Shows the Last Activity date filter in the toolbar.

property.name: showFilterButton
property.label: Show Filter Button
property.description: Shows a Filter button next to the scope toggle (placeholder — not wired to real filter criteria yet).

property.name: showViewAllFooter
property.label: Show View All Footer
property.description: Hides the pager UI and shows a 'Showing X of Y' + View All footer instead, for dashboard-preview placements.

property.name: viewAllUrl
property.label: View All URL
property.description: Site-relative path the View All footer button navigates to, e.g. /envelope/envelope-list.
